privateTakeoverUnsupported: Upgrade this computer to enable private takeover.
privateTakeoverVisible: The private screen is visible in this window and clears when takeover ends.

location_help_server: Use an isolated browser on the computer running the aihubot service. If the service runs elsewhere, work happens there.
location_cloud_unconfigured: This workspace has no managed cloud computer yet. You can also connect your own cloud server.
location_help_remote: Connect a computer you have set up, such as your Mac, a Linux computer, or a cloud server.
location_server: Execution on the aihubot server computer
location_none: Choose a work computer to use computer tools
location_pairing_summary: Pair a computer you manage to use it for Bot work.
location_pairing_policy: Bots follow the current computer’s authorization setting. Watch tasks on the Bot’s screen and use private takeover when available.
location_cloud_recovery: Refresh the status before retrying. If the cloud computer stays unavailable, ask your deployment administrator to check its binding and connection.
pair_setup: Set up a Mac, Linux computer, or your own cloud server
pair_install: On the computer you want to pair, open the aihubot source folder in an interactive terminal and install its dependencies.
pair_run_command: Run the pairing command from that folder.
pair_desktop_setup: Build the Mac helper with npm run desktop:build, then grant the helper Accessibility permission on that Mac.
pair_use_output: Keep that terminal open. Paste the address and token it prints below. Stopping the command invalidates that token.
pair_network: A loopback address works only when aihubot’s service runs on the same computer. From another computer, use an HTTPS address that the aihubot service can reach through your configured network.
pair_origin: If your deployment uses a public HTTPS origin, add --origin with that exact origin to the command.
pair_copy_failed: Select the command and copy it manually.
pair_address_help: Use HTTPS or a loopback HTTP address. Keep the connection token out of chat.
pair_recovery: Check that the work process is running, the service can reach its address, and the token and workspace match. A previously configured computer may require its own setup guide.
pair_per_screen: Ready status checked when preparing the Bot’s screen
local_shared_browser: Bots share one isolated browser on the server computer and take turns using it.
shared_screen_description: Bots take turns using this screen.
remote_shared_browser: Bots take turns using the isolated browser on this computer.
shared_desktop_description: Bots take turns using the desktop on this computer.
ask_owner_to_prepare: Ask the workspace owner to prepare this Bot's screen.
inlineApprovalUnknown: This decision has not been confirmed. Refresh its status before making another decision.
inlineApprovalChanged: This request changed. Refresh and review it before deciding.
inlineApprovalMissing: This action is no longer available. Open the computer panel to check the outcome.
inlineApprovalFailed: Approval status could not be confirmed. Please refresh later.
locationHelpMac: Use the isolated browser on this Mac or choose Mac apps in the computer panel.
macAppsScope: Use Accessibility to identify controls in open Mac apps. Clicks and text replacements follow this computer’s authorization setting.
macAppsHelp: On the Mac, open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility. Enable aihubot or its listed helper or launcher, then choose Check permissions again. Your saved full access remains in place; no new grant or client restart is needed.
macAppsNeedsPermission: Mac app control needs Accessibility permission
macAppsInstructions: Open the app on this Mac and tell the Bot which control to click or which text field to replace. For example, ask it to click Clear in Calculator.
macAppsOpenInstructions: Ask the Bot to open an installed app, click a control, or replace text. For example, say “Open Calculator”. Full access lets it proceed directly.
macAppsTargetUnavailable: Ask the Bot to inspect the app again to get a valid target.
macAppsOpenTargetUnavailable: Ask the Bot to look up the installed app again.
authorizationScope: All Bots use this computer’s default permissions for tasks you start in this workspace on “{{name}}”.
authorizationConfirmHelp: Review each action before the Bot makes changes.
authorizationFullHelp: Let Bots act on this computer without repeated confirmation.
authorizationCapabilityHelp: Full access covers available browser, app, file, command and skill script actions.
authorizationRevokeHelp: Includes browser, apps, files, commands and skill scripts. Choose “Ask each time” to revoke at any time.
authorizationOwnerOnly: Only the workspace owner can enable full access.
authorizationChanged: The computer has changed. Refresh its status before changing authorization.
authorizationOnceOnly: Approval applies only to this action.
